all.src: Net debit <= 70% of wing width; target <= 60% so the structure pays at least 0.6:1.
OI >= 500 and per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 10% of mid) on all four contracts.

management.src: Close at 50% of max profit, i.e. when mark >= debit + 0.5*(width - debit).
Stop: close if mark <= 50% of the debit paid.

exits.src: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if either short wing is ITM with extrinsic < $0.10 - this is exactly the winning scenario, so the guard fires on winners, not losers.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before the ex-date if the short call wing is ITM with extrinsic below the dividend.

safety_gaps.why: the structure has 2 short leg(s) and no compiled assignment guard. These are AMERICAN options on shares: a short that finishes in the money delivers 100 shares per contract the account never sized for.
the document names a stop and none compiled. A strategy that looks armed and is missing its stop is the failure this whole pipeline exists to prevent.
